class.name: FellowMotionMatcher3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: motion matching on a [Skeleton3D] — clips searched for the frame that continues the pose and follows the desired trajectory, blended by inertialization, feet locked with IK.
class.description: A modifier of a [Skeleton3D] whose bones are a [FellowMotionDatabase]'s. Gameplay sets [member desired_velocity] (and [member desired_facing]); a simulated character follows them with critically damped springs, and every [member search_interval] its predicted trajectory (1/3, 2/3 and 1 s ahead, relative to the character) and the current frame's pose features query the database. The best frame, when it is not the current one, is blended in by inertialization. The character's root ([member root_path], by default the skeleton's parent) moves with the animation's own root motion, pulled towards the simulation within [member clamp_distance]; the skeleton's transform relative to it is taken as identity, the root's +Z as forward. Feet in contact are locked and reached with two-bone IK. With [member lod_distances] it searches less often, then skips the IK and updates at a quarter of the rate farther from the camera. See [code]docs/decisions/0149-motion-matching.md[/code].

method.name: advance
method.description: One update: the simulation, the search when due, playback, inertialization, the root's motion and the feet. Called by the skeleton's modifier processing when [member auto_update] is on.

method.name: advance_group
method.description: [method advance] for several matchers at once: their updates run on the [WorkerThreadPool], then their roots are moved on the calling thread. Use it with [member auto_update] off.

method.name: get_character_position
method.description: Where the character's root is (the animation's root motion pulled towards the simulation).

method.name: get_foot_positions
method.description: The left and right ankles after the IK, in world space.

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Every matcher's updates, searches (count, microseconds, frames checked), transitions and updates per LOD since [method reset_global_stats].

method.name: get_last_search
method.description: The last search's query, result and current features in their units, the frame and clip found, its cost.

method.name: get_lod
method.description: The LOD level of the last update (0-2).

method.name: get_simulation_position
method.description: The simulated character's position (where gameplay put it).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: This matcher's searches, transitions, search microseconds, foot sliding while in contact ([code]foot_slide_distance[/code], [code]foot_slide_locked[/code], [code]foot_contact_time[/code], [code]foot_slide_speed[/code]), [code]trajectory_error[/code] (the mean distance between the character and the simulation), popping ([code]pop_p50_mm[/code], [code]pop_p99_mm[/code], [code]pop_p999_mm[/code], [code]pop_max_mm[/code]: per frame the largest second difference of the hips' and legs' joints), the clip, frame and LOD. With [member ground_adaptation]: [code]hips_drop_mm[/code] (how far the hips are lowered now) and [code]hips_drop_min_mm[/code] (the lowest since [method reset_stats]), [code]ground_offsets_mm[/code] (each foot's ground over the root's, as a [Vector2]: left, right), and [code]toe_positions[/code] (where the toes were shown, global).

method.name: reset
method.description: Starts again from the root's transform at the next update.

method.name: teleport
method.description: Puts the simulation and the character at [param position] facing [param facing], at rest.

members.member: How fast the character is pulled towards the simulation (the adjustment's half-life, limited to half the root's own speed).
Update in the skeleton's modifier processing; off: call [method advance].
The character never farther from the simulation than this.
The motion to match.
The direction to face; zero: the direction of [member desired_velocity].
The velocity on the ground the character should reach.
Two-bone IK of the legs reaching the locked feet.
A foot in contact (the database's contacts) stays where it landed until it lifts or the animation pulls it [member unlock_radius] away.

Fits the character to uneven ground (milestone 56): rays straight down against the physics world (the bodies of [member ground_collision_mask]) under the root and under each foot's heel and toe, cast on the main thread before each update. The root follows the ground's height under it (eased), each foot is placed on the highest ground under it — its height over the root's ground added to the animated foot's — by the leg's two-bone IK (onto higher ground four times as fast as down: a foot landing on a step does not sink into it), the hips are lowered as far as the lower foot must reach down (so that the leg over higher ground bends instead of the other overstretching), and a foot that is down turns to the ground's slope ([member ground_alignment], at most 35 degrees). On flat ground the pose is the one without it. Needs [member foot_ik] for the feet.
With [member ground_adaptation], a foot in contact turns to the slope of the ground under it.
The physics layers [member ground_adaptation]'s rays hit (leave the characters' own bodies out).
With [member ground_adaptation], the feet placed on the ground and the hips lowered; [code]false[/code]: only the root follows the ground's height.
How fast the feet's ground offsets and the hips follow the ground (the root at twice this), in seconds to halve the difference.
How far above and below the character's ground [member ground_adaptation] looks for ground, in metres: the highest step up or down it follows in a frame, and the farthest a foot is moved.
Transitions blended by inertialization (the offset between the poses decays); off: hard cuts.
The offsets' half-life.
Distances from the camera: beyond the first, searches half as often and no foot IK; beyond the second, a quarter as often and updates at a quarter of the rate.
The node moved with the character; empty: the skeleton's parent.
The simulation's turning half-life.
Seconds between searches (and a search when the desired velocity changes by 0.1 m/s, or the clip ends).
Pull the character towards the simulation (and clamp it); off: the root follows the animation alone.
A locked foot is released when the animation's foot is this far from it.
The simulation's acceleration half-life.
